text: Trade only 1 to 3 percent risk per trade.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer

text: Don't increase TP or SL while a trade is running.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer

text: Don't over leverage because you think the stop loss is tight and price won't get there.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer

text: Don't go all in and hope it goes well.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer

text: After a good trade, follow the same risk if you want to enter another trade and analyze with the same rules.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer

text: Don't double down on risk after a win or a loss, follow a risk discipline.
author: builder (Tim), not an independent volunteer
